references.text: Describes the same abominable practices that led to the nations being driven out of the land
God detests the customs of the nations and drives them from the land because of their abominations
Explains that the Lord drives out the nations because of their wickedness and abominations
Idolatry and its objects are an abomination to the Lord
The religious practices of the nations are abominations that the Lord hates
Abominations lead to being rejected by the Lord
Abominations led to destruction and expulsion from the land
Sodom was removed because of their abominations
Those who practice abominations will face God's judgment
